meta.title: Treatments — Cottage Aesthetics
meta.description: Nurse-led aesthetic treatments in Hartlebury: microneedling, skin boosters, polynucleotides, dermal fillers and prescription treatments.

pageHero.title: Considered, natural results
pageHero.tag: Every treatment begins with an honest consultation. Prices are held deliberately fair — exceptional care shouldn't mean inflated costs.

sections.title: Start Here
sections.sub: Every journey begins with a relaxed, no-obligation consultation.

cards.title: Free Consultation
cards.body: A calm chat so you feel completely confident in both your chosen treatment and your practitioner before any decisions are made.

sections.title: Microneedling
sections.sub: Stimulating your skin's natural collagen for healthier, brighter, smoother skin.

cards.title: Standard Microneedling
cards.body: Improves texture, reduces acne scarring and softens fine lines using pure Hyaluronic Acid serum.

cards.title: Advanced Microneedling
cards.body: Collagen induction combined with premium medical-grade skincare (Derma 2.0 / Newest), tailored to ageing, pigmentation, acne scarring and rejuvenation.

sections.title: Skin Boosters
sections.sub: Deep hydration and a subtle "5-point facelift" glow — quality from within.

cards.title: Jalupro Super Hydro
cards.body: Deeply hydrates while improving elasticity, firmness and overall skin quality, with subtle lifting and rejuvenation.

cards.title: Profhilo
cards.body: A premium bio-remodelling treatment that intensely hydrates and firms for radiant, refreshed, natural-looking skin.

sections.title: Polynucleotides
sections.sub: Encouraging the skin's natural repair — collagen, hydration and tissue regeneration.

cards.title: Polynucleotides
cards.body: For face, neck, hands and décolletage — improving skin quality, hydration and firmness. Product: Newest.

cards.title: Under-Eye Polynucleotides
cards.body: Designed for the delicate eye area — improving hydration, strengthening the skin and reducing crepey texture. Product: Plinest.

sections.title: Dermal Fillers
sections.sub: Restoring volume and enhancing natural features while keeping perfect facial balance.

cards.title: Lip Enhancement
cards.body: Restores hydration, improves symmetry and defines the lip border for beautifully balanced, natural lips.

cards.title: Chin Enhancement
cards.body: Improves lower-facial balance and profile, adding projection and harmony between chin, lips and nose.

cards.title: Cheek Enhancement
cards.body: Restores youthful volume, enhances cheekbone definition and gives subtle lift to the mid-face.

cards.title: Jawline Contouring
cards.body: Sculpts and defines the jawline, enhancing facial proportions while keeping results natural.

cards.title: Facial Rebalancing & Rejuvenation
cards.body: A detailed facial assessment allowing multiple areas to be treated together, restoring balance, proportion and natural harmony.

rx.title: Prescription Treatments
rx.sub: Wrinkle-relaxing and wellbeing treatments — by prescriber consultation.
rx.note: Due to UK prescribing regulations, these treatments can't be booked online. Select a treatment to see details, then enquire — Purdi will arrange a face-to-face prescriber consultation to determine suitability.

items.title: Botox®
items.body: Temporarily relaxes carefully selected facial muscles to soften existing lines, help prevent deeper lines forming and create a fresher, more rested appearance — while keeping natural expression.

items.title: Relfydess®
items.body: One of the newest botulinum toxin treatments. Its highly purified formulation offers a fast onset and may provide longer-lasting results for suitable clients. Prescriber consultation required.

items.title: Vitamin B12 Complex Injections
items.body: Vitamin B12 supports energy production, healthy nerve function and red blood cell formation. For suitable clients it may help improve energy and reduce fatigue, following assessment by an independent prescriber.
